Simply excellent! Pepo is a 5-year-old black medium schnauzer who had never had a stripping treatment before. His coat was becoming increasingly gray and dull. Alberto accepted the challenge, and after an intense session, he completely transformed it. He's left Pepo looking gorgeous; his experience and dedication are evident. I must also say that he answered many of my questions and gave me advice so that together we can improve Pepo's coat quality and overall health. I highly recommend him!
